europe_now.title: Spanish transport ministry transition following fatal incident
europe_now.summary: The Spanish economy minister has assumed control of the transport ministry following a recent deadly crash. This transition addresses leadership in the sector amidst national attention on the tragedy.

sources.headline: Spanish economy minister takes over transport ministry after deadly crash

europe_now.title: German defense expenditure prioritization debate
europe_now.summary: German defense leadership has defended the national focus on domestic arms industry procurement amid concerns from European partners. Officials rejected assertions that local prioritization undermines broader continental defense cooperation.

sources.headline: Defense chief rejects claims Germany puts its own arms industry ahead of Europe

top_stories.title: United States midterm elections outcome
top_stories.summary: Democratic candidates secured significant victories across multiple states during the United States midterm elections, capturing control of both chambers of Congress. President Donald Trump acknowledged a difficult electoral outcome following the nationwide congressional shifts.
